text:
Hi Everyone,

​Looking for advice regarding our unmarried partnership application at the Be’er Sheva branch.

​My partner is currently in her home country of South Korea waiting for an entry permit. She was previously in Israel on a B1 work visa, switched to a B2 when her contract ended, and left in early September before it expired. We applied in early June 2026, submitted additional documents by email on July 28th, and confirmed they got it in person the next day.

That was the last progress in our case until today.

Today, we received an email scheduling our document check for January 26, 2027, leaving us separated for another three months.

​On top of the wait, she received an unsigned job offer before leaving that is scheduled to start in late January 2027. Additionally, because she previously lived in Germany, we realized after submission that we need two German documents, we currently have one in hand while the second is still processing.

​Is it realistically possible to speed up an appointment at the Be'er Sheva branch, and what is the best way to request it?

​Would mentioning an unsigned job offer help to get an earlier date, or does bringing up employment risk raising a red flag in misrad hapnim?

​Finally, should we wait to bring the German documents straight to the January (hopefully before) appointment, or email them in as soon as the second arrives?

​Thanks for any help or experiences!
